snippet.title: [SMBX2] CAPTAIN TOAD: PRISM STAR QUEST - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Captain Toad: Prism Star Quest is a BRAND NEW SMBX2 adventure based on Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker! Join Captain Toad in his quest to retrieve the Prism Star for Princess Peach's birthday party, while facing off against the dastardly Kuroku the Raccoon Thief and his brand new set of delinquents!

Learn more about Captain Toad: Prism Star Quest here:
https://www.smbxgame.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=90&t=28380
